data.text: Luke, I appreciate you offering to sit out, but I’d rather keep the lake full and everyone earning. My family has fished here for generations; a steady income matters more than a bigger catch today. I propose 10 tons each this month, leaving 50 to replenish to 100. That gives all five of us $10,000 and a plan we can repeat without needing a recovery month. I’ll choose 10 if we all agree to that limit. John, would you support an equal 10-ton share?
